Use it after the upstream server renamed or added tools. In-flight calls are recovered and retried automatically. No gateway restart required.

advancedOauth.title: Pre-registered OAuth client (advanced)
advancedOauth.advancedHint: Most users can leave this blank
advancedOauth.description: For upstream MCP servers that do not support RFC 7591 dynamic client registration (Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Microsoft Graph, ...). Most users should leave this blank — MetaMCP will register automatically.
advancedOauth.clientSecretHelp: Required only for confidential clients. Leave blank for public PKCE clients.
